scenes.headline: How a walking deer becomes one long 3D form
scenes.sub: Mask, depth, pose, and never delete a frame
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Marey! Today: how one video of a walking deer becomes every pose at once, in 3D.

scenes.text: Lift each frame's subject into 3D, place every frame in one shared world, and never delete any of them.
scenes.say: Lift the deer out of each frame into 3D, put every frame in one world, and keep them all.

left.title: 4D reconstruction
items: The deer where it was at one moment
left.say: A 4D reconstruction shows the deer where it was at one moment.

right.title: Time smear
items: Every frame's deer kept in place
Rendered with no time at all
right.say: The time smear keeps every frame's deer and renders them all at once. A chronophotograph you can fly around.

scenes.title: From one frame to the smear

steps.say: First, cut the deer out of every frame. Each masked pixel becomes one Gaussian.
Next, a depth model says how far away each of those pixels is.
The static background gives each frame's camera pose. Pose and depth lift every pixel into one shared world.
Append each frame's points, delete nothing, and render the pile from a high camera.
Here is my rebuild, on a synthetic clip with known answers. Thirty copies fused into one form.
The body slides, so its copies blur into a tube. The legs swing, so they fan out.

scenes.label: Gaussians for all 150 frames at 320 x 180
scenes.note: 933 per frame, one per masked pixel
scenes.say: At low resolution it is cheap: about a hundred and forty thousand Gaussians for the whole clip.

items.say: A pose error slides every copy sideways. One degree moved the deer about twenty-two centimetres.

items.text: Depth drift slides them along rays
items.say: Depth aligned only once scatters copies along their rays. Align every frame to the background.
Blurred depth at the outline flings edge pixels into mid-air. Erode the mask.

scenes.text: The effect is ordinary 3D vision. The craft is in poses, per-frame depth alignment and clean edges.
scenes.say: The effect is ordinary 3D vision. The craft is in poses, per-frame depth alignment, and clean edges.

Registration decides clean smear or ghosts
scenes.say: Mask, depth, pose, and keep every frame. Keep the copies close, and the poses right.
